text:
Announcement was made of a Public Hearing for the proposed Fiscal Year 2024 budgets for the
City of Cheyenne and Board of Public Utilities will be held on Monday, June 12, 2023 at 6:00
p.m. in City Council Chambers, 2101 O°Neil Ave. and via electronic conference meeting.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Committee of the Whole, the
meeting was adjourned at 6:20 p.m.
